content: Evidence indicates that reducing the intake of saturated fats and substituting them with unsaturated fats can lower the risk of cardiovascular disease. Individuals diagnosed with type 2 diabetes are advised to follow a Mediterranean-style diet. This dietary pattern emphasizes the consumption of unsaturated fats, which are primarily derived from sources such as olive oil, nuts, and fish. Adopting this approach has been demonstrated to enhance blood sugar control and improve lipid profiles in this population.
